name: citation-formatting
description: Checks and formats in-text citations and bibliographies against the requested academic style without fabricating source metadata.
---

# Citation and bibliography formatting

Use this skill when asked to check citation consistency, normalize references, or prepare a bibliography.

1. Confirm the required style from the dissertation brief, supervisor, or user. If it is unknown, ask or report that a style decision is needed.
2. Inspect the citation keys, bibliography file, and source records available in the repository.
3. Match in-text citations to bibliography entries and identify uncited entries where the requested scope permits.
4. Verify author, title, year, venue, volume/issue, pages, DOI, and URL against supplied source records or a trusted source when web access is explicitly available.
5. Format only fields that are supported by evidence. Preserve stable citation keys unless asked to change them.
6. Report unresolved, incomplete, duplicate, or inconsistent records in a separate checklist.

Never invent a DOI, page range, author, publication date, quotation, or access detail. A plausible-looking reference is not a verified reference.
